Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of general administration to include ergonomic requirements in its solicitation for discount air travel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ergonomic airline seats; adding a new section tochapter 43.19 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that state employeestravel on airlines as part of their employment and that extendedexposure to nonergonomic airline seats presents a health and safetyrisk to state employees. Therefore, the legislature intends to providefor employees who are engaged in jobrelated travel the same healthyand safe environment that exists in the workplace.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows: When soliciting bids for discount air travel pursuant to thischapter, the department of general administration shall include in thesolicitation a provision requiring airlines to provide seats foremployees that meet current health and safety standards as establishedby the department of labor and industries on all flights reasonablyexpected to be longer than two hours. The solicitation shall also p. 1 SB 5139include a provision requiring a discounted ticket price when theairline is unable to provide a seat for the employee that meets currenthealth and safety standards.
